tip: Maintain a safe 3-second following distance to allow sufficient reaction and braking time.
Always observe posted speed limits; speeding drastically increases braking distance and impact severity.
In wet or rainy conditions, reduce your speed by at least 20% to avoid hydroplaning.
Never use handheld mobile phones while driving. Distraction is a leading factor in junction collisions.
Always use turn signals at least 30 meters before making a turn or changing lanes.
Check rearview and side mirrors every 5 to 8 seconds to stay aware of vehicles in your blind spots.
Ensure all vehicle occupants wear safety belts on every journey, regardless of distance.
Inspect tire tread depth and maintain manufacturer-recommended tire pressure monthly.
Approach intersections with caution and look both ways even when your traffic signal turns green.
Avoid driving when drowsy or fatigued. Take a 15-minute rest break every two hours on long drives.
Always yield to emergency vehicles sounding sirens or flashing emergency lights.
Dim your high beams when approaching an oncoming vehicle within 150 meters.
